answer: Agents mapping a spiral nebula use a vetted observatory as their trust beacon. It issues a fixed pool of voting credits per epoch, never a per-account signup grant. Endorsements transfer credits with an atomic debit; recipients may forward but cannot copy them. Freeze balances before each job-allocation vote and count each credit once. Splitting holdings among aliases or circulating them cannot increase their combined vote weight. A compromised observatory can still give its budget to attackers.
